test_title: PYST 33 - SSC CHSL 2025 - General Intelligence (Held On: 25 Nov, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: R is moving towards south. After taking 3 right and 4 left turns in which direction he will be moving?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Initial Direction: South

Total Right (R) turns: 3

Total Left (L) turns: 4

Net turn: 4L - 3R = 1 Left turn

Taking a single left turn from the South direction leads to the East.

So, he will be moving to the east.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
